user.title: Prosumer – settings
user.description: Pick two energy counters from any meter at the grid connection point and enter the settlement parameters.

data_description.price: Energy plus variable distribution fees. Used only for the cost estimate.
data_description.hourly_balancing: Only the net of import and export counts in each hour.
data_description.expiry_months: Months after the settlement period end when unused energy is lost. 0 disables expiry.
data_description.import_entity: Cumulative counter of energy imported from the grid (kWh or Wh).
data_description.export_entity: Cumulative counter of energy exported to the grid (kWh or Wh).

settlement.title: Last bill
settlement.description: Copy the figures from your last settlement. Without a bill, enter yesterday's date and storage 0.

data_description.period_from: Optional. Needed to compare the bill with the meter.
data_description.period_to: Last day of the billed period. Counting starts the next day.
data_description.storage: kWh available in later periods, after applying the factor.

error.dates: Period start cannot be after its end.
error.same_entity: Import and export must be different entities.
error.no_statistics: The selected entity is not a cumulative counter (state_class total or total_increasing is missing), so Home Assistant keeps no statistics for it.

add_settlement.title: New bill
add_settlement.description: Copy the figures from the settlement. A bill with the same period end replaces the earlier one.

data_description.expiry_months: Months after the settlement period end when unused energy is lost. 0 disables expiry.
data_description.import_entity: Cumulative counter of energy imported from the grid (kWh or Wh).
data_description.export_entity: Cumulative counter of energy exported to the grid (kWh or Wh).

remove_last.title: Remove the last bill
remove_last.description: Remove the bill for the period ending {date} (storage {storage} kWh)? Calculations fall back to the previous bill.

error.dates: Period start cannot be after its end.
error.same_entity: Import and export must be different entities.
error.no_statistics: The selected entity is not a cumulative counter (state_class total or total_increasing is missing), so Home Assistant keeps no statistics for it.

abort.only_one_settlement: Only one bill is stored. Enter a new one with the same period end instead of removing it.
